name: wtfgif

scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:wasm:node && npm run build:wasm:web && npm run build:wasm:quality && npm run build:wasm:simd && npm run build:wasm:simd:quality
scripts.build:wasm:quality: npm run build:wasm:node:quality && npm run build:wasm:web:quality
scripts.build:wasm:simd: npm run build:wasm:node:simd && npm run build:wasm:web:simd
scripts.build:wasm:simd:quality: npm run build:wasm:node:quality:simd && npm run build:wasm:web:quality:simd
scripts.build:wasm:node:quality:simd: node scripts/build-wasm-variant.mjs nodejs pkg-quality-simd quality-only simd
scripts.build:wasm:web:quality:simd: node scripts/build-wasm-variant.mjs web pkg-quality-web-simd quality-only simd
scripts.test:edge: npm run build:wasm && npm run build && npm run validate:edge
scripts.rust:clippy: cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/wtfgif-core/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/wtfgif-core/Cargo.toml --all-targets --features encode-only -- -D warnings
scripts.rust:test: cargo test --manifest-path crates/wtfgif-core/Cargo.toml --release && cargo test --manifest-path crates/wtfgif-core/Cargo.toml --release --features encode-only
scripts.rust:check: npm run rust:fmt && npm run rust:clippy && npm run rust:test
scripts.bench:cold: npm run build && npm run build:native:prototype && node scripts/bench-cold.mjs
scripts.bench:decode: npm run build && node scripts/bench-drop-in.mjs decode
scripts.bench:encode: npm run build && node scripts/bench-drop-in.mjs encode
scripts.bench:race: npm run build:wasm:web:quality && npm run build:wasm:web:quality:simd && npm run build && node scripts/bench-encoder-race.mjs
scripts.bench:in-process: npm run build && npm run build:native:prototype && node scripts/bench.mjs
scripts.bench:native:prototype: npm run build && npm run build:native:prototype && node scripts/bench-native-prototype.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run audit && npm run rust:check && npm run build:wasm && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate:wasm-core && npm run test:conformance:independent && npm run validate:edge && npm run test:package
scripts.prepack: npm run build:wasm && npm run build

author: Matt Popovich
description: Latency-optimized GIF encoding and omggif-compatible decoding for Node.js, browsers, Workers, and edge runtimes.
